name: button
title: Button
description: Button with primary, secondary, quiet, and danger variants, sm/md/lg sizes, and a visible focus ring.

files.content:
<template rust:component="Button">
  <button
    type="button"
    class="tesso-button"
    class:tesso-button-primary='state.variant == "primary"'
    class:tesso-button-secondary='state.variant == "secondary"'
    class:tesso-button-quiet='state.variant == "quiet"'
    class:tesso-button-danger='state.variant == "danger"'
    class:tesso-button-sm='state.size == "sm"'
    class:tesso-button-md='state.size == "md"'
    class:tesso-button-lg='state.size == "lg"'
    on:click="state.press()"
  >
    <Children></Children>
  </button>
</template>
